title: A quiet hello
style_bible: Simple paper-cut illustration. One orange fox with a white chest, black paws and a teal scarf sits on a plain warm cream background. Fixed full-body camera, soft even light, consistent proportions. No text or additional characters.

shots.prompt: The seated fox raises its right forepaw once in a quiet greeting, then holds it up. Keep the body, camera and background still. One continuous action, no scene change.
shots.first_frame_target: The fox is seated, facing the camera, with both forepaws down.
shots.last_frame_target: The same fox holds its right forepaw up; the scarf and framing are unchanged.
